title: Austin Leadership Shakeup, Airport Relocation
summary:
*   Austin saw a major leadership change as City Manager Jorge Carrasco's resignation was accepted, with John Ware immediately appointed as the Acting City Manager.
*   The city confirmed its decision to relocate the Robert Mueller Municipal Airport, with official descriptions of the new site published.
*   An economic development policy was reversed with the directive to dissolve the Austin Reinvestment Zone No. One Tax Increment Zone.
*   Discussions continued on the city's waste-to-energy plant, with plans for a dedicated work session to further address the project.

consistent with the long-range best interest of the City of Austin, and that a report be
given to the City Council on the actions taken pursuant to this resolution and the cost
thereof, within one week of completion of the tasks required hereunder.
